fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of a master's in data science at Southampton? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 deadlines.

The Data Science MSc is a **1-year**, full-time course at the Highfield campus. You study for 12 months, from September 2027 to the following September. It is **not a conversion course**: it expects a computing, maths, statistics or physics degree.

Compulsory modules are Data Visualisation, Foundations of Data Science, Machine Learning Technologies, and Research Methods and Project Preparation. Options include Advanced Databases, Data Mining, Deep Learning Technologies and Natural Language Processing. You finish with a research project of 3 to 4 months, assessed by a **15,000-word** dissertation.

The course is accredited by the Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET).

For the wider university, see our [University of Southampton page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-southampton).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a 2:1 in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, mathematics or statistics, or physics. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade. You also need a 2:1 in 1 programming module (such as Python, Java or C++) and 1 advanced maths module, ideally statistics and probability.

**Indian marks.** Southampton puts Indian institutions into 3 tiers. For a 2:1 its India page lists **60%** (Tier 1), **65%** (Tier 2) or **70%** (Tier 3). Search the tier list on the [India page](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/international/entry-qualification-equivalencies/india) to find yours. The same page also gives a general range of 55% to 65% for a 2:1, which does not match the table, so ask the International Office if you are near the line.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. This course asks for **IELTS 6.5** overall, with **6.0** in reading, writing, speaking and listening. Southampton runs pre-sessional English courses if you need to raise your score.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Southampton's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£36,800** for a year of study, for September 2027. Southampton says the fee stays the same each year.

Southampton is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, September 2027 | £36,800 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,203 × 9 months | £10,827 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£49,349** |

The sum is £36,800 + £10,827 + £558 + £1,164 = £49,349. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule for courses outside London rises from **£1,171** to **£1,203** a month for visa applications made on or after **30 November 2026**. A September 2027 student applies in 2027, so plan on **£1,203** for each month of your course, up to **9 months** (£10,827). You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row, and the 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** International full-time students pay **£2,000** of the tuition fee in advance, as a deposit.

**Application fee.** There is no application assessment fee for courses starting in 2027.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**Dean of FEPS Global Talent Award.** A **£10,000** tuition fee reduction for international students. Up to 5 are offered across the faculty, and **2** go to Electronics and Computer Science, the school that runs this course. India is on the eligible country list. With it, your first-year total falls to **£39,349**.

To be eligible you must:

- be a permanent resident of an eligible country
- be self-funded and pay overseas fees
- hold an offer for an eligible course and exceed its entry requirements
- send a supporting statement of up to 250 words by **30 April 2027, 5pm UK time**

The award is competitive. **Stacking:** if you win more than one Southampton scholarship, you only receive the highest-value one. Southampton graduates can get a **10%** alumni discount. Read the [award terms](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/study/fees-funding/scholarships/engineering-physical-science-global).

## Deadlines and intakes

| Intake | Who applies | Deadline | Where to apply |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | International applicants | 18 August 2027, midday UK time | Southampton postgraduate admissions system |
| September 2027 | UK applicants | 1 September 2027, midday UK time | Southampton postgraduate admissions system |
| Global Talent Award | International applicants | 30 April 2027, 5pm UK time | Scholarship application form |

The course may close earlier if places fill. Southampton says a response can take up to **12 weeks**, so apply well before April if you want the scholarship.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rule.** Make sure your degree subject and modules match the list above.
2. **Prepare your documents.** You need your degree certificate and transcripts, your IELTS result and a personal statement on your knowledge of the subject, why you want the course and how you will use it. References are not required.
3. **Apply online.** Use the Apply link on the [course page](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/courses/data-science-masters-msc) to open the postgraduate admissions system.
4. **Apply for the Global Talent Award** by 30 April 2027, once you hold an offer.
5. **Accept your offer within 30 working days** and pay the **£2,000** deposit. The university then issues your CAS. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the electronic letter your visa application needs.
6. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
7. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Careers.** Southampton lists graduate roles such as data scientist, machine learning engineer and data analyst.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you have a computing, maths, statistics or physics degree with programming
- you have 60% to 70%, depending on your university's tier
- you can apply early for the £10,000 award

**Think carefully if:**

- your degree is in a non-computing subject, because this is not a conversion course
- you are counting on the scholarship, because only 2 go to this school

faq_json.q: Is the Southampton MSc Data Science a conversion course?
faq_json.a: No. You need a 2:1 in computing, maths, statistics or physics, plus a programming and an advanced maths module.

faq_json.q: How much does the Southampton MSc Data Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £36,800 for September 2027. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the year comes to £49,349.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need?
faq_json.a: Southampton's India page lists 60%, 65% or 70% for a 2:1, depending on your university's tier.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Yes. The Dean of FEPS Global Talent Award gives £10,000 off tuition. It is competitive, with 2 awards for Electronics and Computer Science, and closes on 30 April 2027.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for September 2027?
faq_json.a: International applicants must apply by 18 August 2027, midday UK time. There is no application fee for 2027.
